lead.t: Imaging alone and serology for hydatid disease provide a specific diagnosis

snip.t: Imaging alone and serology for hydatid disease provide a specific diagnosis
Cystic hydatid disease → Fluid-filled cysts grow slowly, causing organ compression.

qs.q: A 35-year-old patient is diagnosed with obstructive jaundice caused by hydatid disease of the biliary tree. What is the appropriate targeted treatment approach for this parasitic cause?
qs.e: Parasites and hydatid disease affecting the biliary system are treated with endoscopic removal combined with anthelmintics such as albendazole. Surgical resections are reserved for complex tumors or strictures.
